0342aad2db9e.title: Cloud Infrastructure Intern
0342aad2db9e.description_html:
Pretend Health AI is looking for a Cloud Infrastructure Intern to join a small team shipping real features.

What you will do

  • Design, build and test production code
  • Pair with senior engineers
  • Present your project at the end of the summer

What we look for

  • Currently pursuing a BS/MS in CS or a related field
  • Experience with one of Python, Go, TypeScript or C++
  • Curiosity and clear written communication

Pay range: $42.00 to $55.00 USD hourly. We do not sponsor work visas for this role.

Equal opportunity employer. Accommodation requests are welcome.
